_doc: Key reference questions asked at framing for every source dataset (sds) and data product (dp). reference_questions.py pre-fills the evidence from DPV1, the migration map and the deployment repo and writes 1-framing/04-key-reference-questions.md. 'options' is the answer list the agent shows (recommended first, then 'Other'). required = the gate reference_questions_answered (data product) or the review warning (source dataset) waits for an answer. 'when' limits a question to scopes whose scenario or modifiers match.

questions.question: Are the names right: project or group, workspace per environment, Lakehouse or Warehouse, database project?
options: Use the name of the existing Fabric build

questions.question: Do Fabric items for this project already exist (older build, other naming)? Reuse, replace or rename them?
DPV1 objects are named after this project but no project lists them (triggers, scripts, pipelines, notebooks). Do they belong here?
Which schedule applies in Fabric (DPV1 triggers are listed)? It is documented, not activated.
Monitoring, logging or alerting configs use the DPV1 pipeline names. Which must follow the new Fabric names?
Who reads this project's data (products, notebooks, reports, exports)? Which table and column names must not change?
options: Keep every name as in DPV1

questions.question: Which Fabric connection is used per environment for each source system (linked services and Key Vault secret names are listed)?
Load mode: keep what DPV1 really does (full or incremental), or change it?
Catalog tables that no data product reads: keep ingesting them or leave them out?
Files (SharePoint, Excel, CSV) are ingested next to the database. Which files or sheets become tables, under which names, and which connection reads them?
options: One catalog row per file or sheet, same source dataset

questions.question: The API takes the watermark in its request. Which date format and parameter does each API use, and which overlap (days) is safe?
Expected volume and freshness (largest tables, run time target)?
Which source datasets does the product read, and are they all migrated and published (contract)? Workspace, Lakehouse and schema per environment?
Which source tables does the code read, by the name used in the code (INP_, spot_, external tables), and does each exist in a source dataset? Any read that is in no source catalog?
options: All mapped to source dataset tables
Add the missing tables to the source dataset

questions.question: Is there a DACPAC or database project for the dedicated pool, or a read login to extract it? Where is the code?
options: Build it from the DPV1 code
Here is the DACPAC or project path
Extract it from the live pool

questions.question: Where does the modeling live (LDW and OUT views, procedures, notebooks, dataflows)? Must surrogate keys keep their values? Which collation applies?
options: Keep the logic and the keys as in DPV1, case-insensitive collation

questions.question: Is the Warehouse copied back to SPOT for consumers? Who reads that copy, and do reports or semantic models exist that bind to the tables?
options: Drop the copy-back: consumers read the Warehouse
Keep a copy for named consumers

questions.question: Which row-level rules, AD groups or permissions apply to the tables and views?
options: Defined by the Fabric access rules

questions.question: Does the product run after the source run (same trigger chain in DPV1)? What must wait for what?
options: Run after the source datasets finish

questions.question: Where do the DPV1 numbers for the equivalence test come from (row counts and checksums per table)?
options: Read access to the dedicated pool
An export of counts and checksums
Compare with the source tables only
